# Project Guidelines

## Code Style

Python code follows standard practices. Reference working implementations like [CT08_05/project5_schoolattendance.py](CT08_05/project5_schoolattendance.py) for multi-function projects and [CT08_08/project8_vowelsherlock.py](CT08_08/project8_vowelsherlock.py) for file I/O with error handling.

## Architecture

This is a 16-lesson Python learning course with standalone projects per lesson. Each lesson (CT08_01 to CT08_16) contains a lesson guide, lesson code, and project code. CT08_MidSem contains midterm questions.

## Build and Test

Run Python files directly with `python filename.py`. No build system. For debugging exercises in CT08_12 and CT08_13, identify and fix syntax/logic errors.

## Conventions

- Code-embedded task descriptions in comments.
- Debugging practice: CT08_12 and CT08_13 contain intentional errors.
- File I/O uses relative paths; run from lesson directory.
- Data files (e.g., sherlock.txt, results.txt) are included for exercises.

See individual lesson guides (lessonX_guide.md) for specific instructions. Reference [CT08_12/lesson12.py](CT08_12/lesson12.py) for correct library implementation.
